lines.zh: 我一节一节往前推，骨头互相磨。
lines.en: I push forward segment by segment, bones grinding.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面滑，沙子都分开。
lines.en: I slide along the sand, and it parts.

lines.zh: 我身体里没有肉，只有骨。
lines.en: No flesh in me. Only bone.
I sway my head as I go.

lines.zh: 土下面的路，我比谁都熟。
lines.en: I know the roads under the earth.

lines.zh: 我一节一节地拱，像条链子。
lines.en: I arch along like a chain.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方，沙地上有沟。
lines.en: A furrow follows me through the sand.
Segment by segment, I count myself.

lines.zh: 我的头在最后才跟上来。
lines.en: My head catches up last.

lines.zh: 我从地里冒出来，又钻进去。
lines.en: I surface, then burrow back down.

lines.zh: 这一带的地，我探过一次。
lines.en: I've sounded this ground before.

lines.zh: 我的骨头很长，能伸好远。
lines.en: My bones are long. They reach far.

lines.zh: 沙粒卡在骨缝里，响个不停。
lines.en: Sand grits in my joints. Constant sound.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地，把身体盘过来。
lines.en: I coil my body slowly around.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面，听下面的动静。
lines.en: Flat to the ground, I listen below.
Loose soil here. Easy to burrow.
I coil and raise my head.

lines.zh: 没有眼睛，可我数得清你的脚步。
lines.en: No eyes, but I can count your steps.
Wind through my ribs makes a sound.
I wait for the ground to tremble.

lines.zh: 骨头缝里没有肉，只有风。
lines.en: Between my bones there's no flesh, only wind.
Old cracks in my bone.

lines.zh: 这一片没有活物，很安静。
lines.en: Nothing alive here. Quiet.
Bone knocks bone with a click.
My joints click. Always.

lines.zh: 有东西经过了，我记下了。
lines.en: Something passed. Noted.
I lie buried, waiting for a tremor.
I lower my head to the sand.

lines.zh: 你站在我盘起来的圈外。
lines.en: You stand outside my coil.
I raise my head square to you.

lines.zh: 你没有骨头露在外面，很奇怪。
lines.en: Your bones aren't showing. Odd.

lines.zh: 我闻不到你的味道，可我知道你。
lines.en: I can't smell you, yet I know you.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，骨头一节节动。
lines.en: I come closer, joint by joint.

lines.zh: 你退了一步，地面响了一下。
lines.en: You step back; the ground ticks.
This body of mine won't be broken.
Won't you come down and look?
I've lain here a long time.
I hear the tremor of your steps.

lines.zh: 一节被打掉了，我又接上。
lines.en: A segment is knocked off. I rejoin it.
Half a bone broken. Still moving.

lines.zh: 我退下沙里，重新盘起来。
lines.en: I sink into the sand and recoil.

lines.zh: 我没有疼，只是少了一截。
lines.en: No pain. Only one less segment.

lines.zh: 这一下，把我打歪了半圈。
lines.en: That knocked me half a coil off.

lines.zh: 一节一节的骨头，从土里钻出来。
lines.en: Segment by segment, I rise from the soil.
Sand in my joints. Gritty.

lines.zh: 我还能动，比你想的结实。
lines.en: I can still move. Tougher than you thought.
I draw my body in to guard my head.
I've marked where that came from.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，我只需要动。
lines.en: I don't eat. I only need to move.
That thing — I've no mouth to bite it.
You hold it up; I coil over.

lines.zh: 我把头伸过去，只是看看。
lines.en: I reach my head over. Only to look.
That smell. I feel nothing.
I go around what's in your hand.
No appetite. Only bone.
Leave it and I'll pretend I didn't see.
That matters to you, doesn't it.
I coil up and stop looking at it.
You strike bone. Very hard.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的一节被撞开了。
lines.en: That knocked one of my segments loose.
I coil away without touching.
I pass under your feet.

lines.zh: 骨头撞在一起，声音很脆。
lines.en: Bone strikes bone. A sharp sound.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，正好是我要过的路。
lines.en: Where you stand is the path I need.
I withdraw, then circle back.

lines.zh: 这一下，把沙都扬起来了。
lines.en: That threw the sand up.
Don't step on my bones. They break.

lines.zh: 我退下地面，从下面过去。
lines.en: I sink under the ground and pass below.

lines.zh: 骨头与骨头，不需要说话。
lines.en: Bone to bone needs no words.

lines.zh: 我把头绕过去，它接住了。
lines.en: I loop my head over and it meets me.

lines.zh: 两具骨架缠在一起，像一条链。
lines.en: Two skeletons twined like a chain.
Quiet underground. Only us.
We line up joint to joint.

lines.zh: 这件事，地面上的看不见。
lines.en: Nothing above ground sees this.
Sand will fall and cover the traces.
I coil once and close around it.
We part only much later.
Its bone is whiter than mine.

lines.zh: 我把头伸过去，碰了一下。
lines.en: I reach my head over and touch it.

lines.zh: 我没有手，只能用下巴推。
lines.en: No hands. I push with my jaw.

lines.zh: 这个我不能拿，只能绕开。
lines.en: I can't take it. Only go around.
I push it into the sand and bury it.
It's wedged in my joints.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖身子，把它抖掉。
lines.en: I shake and it falls free.

lines.zh: 这东西也太小了，感觉不到。
lines.en: Too small. I can't feel it.
I don't intend to take it.

lines.zh: 下面还有更多这样的东西。
lines.en: There's more of this below.
I lever it up with a bone.
The ground ticks. That's you walking.

lines.zh: 我把头抬起来，对着你的方向。
lines.en: I raise my head toward you.
I come from underground. Quickly.

lines.zh: 你打不断我，我可以慢慢来。
lines.en: You can't break me. I can take my time.
I coil, ready to spring.

lines.zh: 这一片的地，就是我的身体。
lines.en: This ground is my body.

lines.zh: 你站的地方，我下面是空的。
lines.en: Where you stand, it's hollow beneath.
I open my jaws. No teeth, though.
I've prepared this a long while.

lines.zh: 你退到石头上，也不安全。
lines.en: Retreat to stone. Not safe either.

lines.zh: 我的骨头一节节绷紧了。
lines.en: My segments tighten one by one.

lines.zh: 你听见下方的声音了吗？
lines.en: Did you hear the sound below?
When I move, the sand turns over.
This time I won't come head-on.
I follow beneath the ground.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我下面的沙就动一下。
lines.en: Each of your steps stirs the sand beneath.
Head out, then back in.
No hurry. There's nowhere for you.
Bone sounds from every direction.

lines.zh: 我绕了半圈，正对你脚下。
lines.en: Half a circle and I'm under your feet.

lines.zh: 你退到沙上，就更容易了。
lines.en: Back onto sand and it's easier.
I haven't shown my head once.

lines.zh: 这一片的土，被我钻松了。
lines.en: I've loosened all this soil.

lines.zh: 你听到的那个声音，越来越近。
lines.en: That sound is getting closer.
I stop. That frightens you more.
A little closer and I surface.
I keep following. Patiently.
You're standing right on top of me.

lines.zh: 我从沙里钻出来，撞上去。
lines.en: I burst out of the sand and strike.
A bone lashes out. Hard.

lines.zh: 这一下，把你推到石头上。
lines.en: That threw you against stone.
I wrap around, coil by coil.

lines.zh: 我的头撞过去，比骨头还硬。
lines.en: My head strikes. Harder than bone.
After the blow I burrow back.
Light, but unsettling.
My bone segments tighten ring by ring.

lines.zh: 你打断了半节，还能再长。
lines.en: You broke a segment. It'll come back.

lines.zh: 我从上面落下来，砸得很实。
lines.en: I drop from above. Solid impact.

lines.zh: 沙先鼓起来，然后我才出来。
lines.en: The sand swells first. Then I emerge.

lines.zh: 我把头从土里拔出来，抖了抖。
lines.en: I pull my head out of the soil and shake it.

lines.zh: 一节一节，我把自己拉上来。
lines.en: Segment by segment, I draw myself up.

lines.zh: 这里的沙，比我记得的细。
lines.en: Finer sand than I remember.
I coil and listen all around.
The old breaks in my bone remain.
Something alive walks above.
I raise my head, half a length of bone showing.
It's hollow under all of this.
I lay my body out. Very long.
Fire scorches my bones black.

lines.zh: 我从高处砸下，骨节散了几块。
lines.en: I hit the ground and few joints scatter.

lines.zh: 水灌进骨缝，我沉了下去。
lines.en: Water fills my joints and I sink.
The blast flings my joints apart.

lines.zh: 东西卡在骨缝里，动起来响。
lines.en: Something's caught in a joint. It clacks.

lines.zh: 光罩着我，骨节都不听使唤。
lines.en: Light wraps me and my joints won't obey.
Too long without moving. My bones are dry.

lines.zh: 雷顺着骨串走，我抖个不停。
lines.en: Lightning runs down my spine of bones.

lines.zh: 下面没有沙，我掉下去了。
lines.en: No sand below. I fall.
